name: dtls-handshake-message-semantic-validation
instr:
pion/dtls cannot semantically validate existing ClientHello, ServerHello, HelloRetryRequest, and EncryptedExtensions values without marshaling or mutation. Add one contract covering ordinary values, hook replacements, and protected-flight results across DTLS 1.2 and DTLS 1.3.

In `github.com/pion/dtls/v4/pkg/protocol/handshake`, make `Message.Validate` and `ValidateMessage` return every deterministic `ValidationIssue` in field order, with immutable issue data and the message type. Validate ClientHello versions, session and cookie widths, cipher and compression vectors, and client-context extension relationships. Validate ServerHello version, session, suite, compression, and contextual extensions, distinguishing selection from retry semantics. EncryptedExtensions must apply only protected-response duplication, placement, and dependency rules; an empty value remains valid without hello fields.

Validate incoming and hook-replaced messages before emission or observable transcript, retry, resumption, negotiation, or application state changes. Peer semantic validation failures are fatal, preserve stable message and issue details and any underlying cause, and leave retryable connection state uncommitted. Apply the same meanings to full, retry, and resumed DTLS 1.2 flights and initial, retry, ServerHello, and EncryptedExtensions DTLS 1.3 flights.

In `github.com/pion/dtls/v4`, `HandshakeValidationObserver` receives `handshake.ValidationReport` values. `HandshakeValidationDefault`, `
